blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Lower Mary Hill Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Lower Mary Hill is the low ground at the foot of Mary Hill; main street Pitt River Road; no City sub-area boundary is published.
Working frame: bypass and hill north, Fraser River south, Shaughnessy Street west, Pitt River east.
Kilmer Park, 1844 Pooley Avenue, and Thompson Park, 1842 Morgan Avenue, are its City parks.

blocks.text: Lower Mary Hill Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Houses sit on flat lots below the 1950s Mary Hill curving-street pattern; the older pattern here is grid, smaller lots, rear lanes.

blocks.text: Lower Mary Hill Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Flood/dike rules are the local set: much of the city is in the Fraser/Pitt floodplain behind dikes; this sub-area is on that low ground.
Floodplain maps: City flood page; check the lot there.
A Development Variance Permit cannot vary a floodplain specification, use or density.

blocks.text: Lower Mary Hill Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Flood events: sandbag stations at Cedar Park and the Public Works Yard; PoCo Trail at the Kingsway underpass and Gates Park parking lot close at high water.
Nine City pump stations pump creek water over the dikes when flood boxes close at high river levels.
Waste: five zones; green weekly, blue/grey alternating; look up by address.

items.t: A home with a secondary suite is billed for main dwelling and suite; a suite exemption must be filed annually by December 31 or it will be denied.

items.t: Route 188: Pitt River Road, stops at Mary Hill Road and Shaughnessy Street, then Coast Meridian Road to Coquitlam Central Station.
Port Coquitlam Station, 2125 Kingsway Avenue, west side: weekday West Coast Express, mornings in, evenings back.

items.t: Start on the City flood page, which covers dike and pump-station patrols in freshet season; ask what flood construction level applies before a rebuild.

blocks.text: Lower Mary Hill home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

11 houses sold in Lower Mary Hill with a median price of $1,255,000 (the middle half sold between $1,139,440 and $1,337,500), taking a median of 23 days to sell at 95.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $588 per square foot, a median year built of 1975 and a median lot of 6,045 square feet.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Lower Mary Hill
Houses on level lots off Pitt River Road make up Lower Mary Hill, the flat, riverside part of Mary Hill. Kilmer Park and the Traboulay PoCo Trail along the river are the local outdoors.
